description: This Java class implements a singleton pattern for managing global mapping strategies within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends MappingStrategies and provides methods to instantiate and retrieve a singleton instance, registering various global registries such as error, command, response, and event registries.

classes.name: GlobalMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that manages global mapping strategies, extending MappingStrategies, and queues up several global registries for application-wide use.

methods.name: GlobalMappingStrategies()
methods.description: Default constructor used via reflection to create an instance with global strategies.

methods.name: getInstance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GlobalMappingStrategies, creating it if necessary.
